map.ROI 公式、与 NPV/IRR 的区别，如何用 ToolBox 快速评估一项投: The ROI formula, how it differs from NPV/IRR, and how to use ToolBox to assess the return on an investment quickly.
map.ROI = (收益 − 成本) / 成本 × 100%。它简单直观，衡量「投入一: ROI = (gain − cost) / cost × 100%. It is simple and intuitive, measuring how much you get back for every unit invested.
map.ROI 不考虑时间维度，一年赚 50% 和十年赚 50% 的 ROI 相同却天差: ROI ignores the time dimension: a 50% return in one year and 50% over ten years give the same ROI but are worlds apart. That is why it is usually paired with NPV/IRR.
map.填入总收益与总成本即得 ROI 百分比；多期项目建议再折算时间价值。: Enter the total gain and the total cost to get the ROI percentage; for a multi-period project, discount for the time value as well.
map.ROI 为负说明什么？: What does a negative ROI mean?
map.说明收益低于成本，即亏损；绝对值越大亏损越严重。: It means the return is below the cost, that is a loss; the larger the absolute value the worse the loss.
map.ROI 和净利率一样吗？: Is ROI the same as net margin?
map.不一样。净利率是会计口径（含税费等），ROI 是投入产出比，定义更灵活。: They are not the same. Net margin is an accounting measure (including taxes and fees) while ROI is a benefit-cost ratio with a more flexible definition.
map.为什么 ROI 高也可能不投？: Why can a high ROI still be a bad investment?
map.若回收周期过长或风险高，时间价值与风险会削弱高 ROI 的吸引力。: If the payback period is too long or the risk is high, the time value and the risk erode the attraction of a high ROI.
